limitations: The 20-case SQL benchmark executes generated attack and legitimate-input pytest checks, but remains a local pattern matrix rather than a public real-world vulnerability corpus.
No live DeepSeek API benchmark was run, so stochastic model pass@k and cost are not measured.
Command injection, path traversal, and dependency cases remain on their existing executors; only SQL injection is migrated to RepairKernel in phase 4.
The built-in SQL security oracle is AST-based. Automated routing additionally requires executable security and business commands.
